stem: The masses, in grams, of small and large bags of flour have the distributions $\text{N}(510, 100)$ and $\text{N}(1015, 324)$ respectively. André selects 4 small bags of flour and 2 large bags of flour at random.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total mass of these 6 bags of flour is less than 4130 g.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total mass of the 4 small bags is more than the total mass of the 2 large bags.
